title: The reasoning of every LLM example: recorded thinking kept whole by the gateway, reasoning from the record, a teacher's only when checked
request: Every LLM example has a reasoning and thinking part, labelled by its source.
plan: The gateway keeps each exchange whole, thinking included.
Reasoning written by code from a decision's or a move's record.
A teacher's reasoning checked: every number from the record, no overclaim.

decisions.decision: A purpose shown cell values keeps only its exchange's shape.
decisions.why: A cell in a prompt must not reach the store.

change: Gateway._keep_exchange (model_exchanges/), store.reasoning (recorded, from_record, check, teacher), the purpose reasoning_teacher and its prompt.

findings.defect: The gateway kept no thinking and cut prompts at 20,000 characters.
findings.scenario: Every exchange's thinking lost; long prompts cut.
findings.cause: Only a prompt, cut, was logged.
findings.fix: Each exchange kept whole in its own log.

findings.defect: Whole exchanges were kept for purposes that may keep no text.
findings.fix: Kept whole only where the purpose keeps text.

findings.defect: The teacher's cap was per call.
findings.fix: One client per run, a CLI that plans without --yes.

outcome: Every model exchange is kept whole with its thinking, and every LLM example can carry reasoning whose source is said.
lessons: Look for truncation in every log a model's output passes through.
risks: The teacher has not run live yet; its reasoning's quality is unmeasured.
